_note: Synthetic only: a seeded simulated Control-IQ wearer (scripts/ui_patient.py) ingested into scratch stores and served by the public API, in process. status.failed adds one invented failed sync attempt.

glossary.meaning: A matured change's result against its before period.
The habit the engine attributes most of a Pattern's occurrences to.
A Trial or a Focus. One is active at a time.
Duration of insulin action: how long the pump counts a bolus as still working, in hours.
Stop watching the active change.
A dated event the engine cites as evidence.
A habit you pinned, watched for adherence and outcome.
Glucose by time of day over the last 30 days: the median and the 10th–90th percentile spread.
Insulin-to-carb ratio, the pump's carb ratio: the grams of carbs one unit of insulin covers.
The standard CGM metrics. Below 54 and Above 250 are shown as subsets of Below 70 and Above 180, never as separate bands of the same total.
glossary.term: In range, Below 70, Below 54, Above 180, Above 250, Mean, GMI, CV, Pre-meal, Post-meal 2 h

glossary.meaning: Insulin sensitivity factor, the pump's correction factor: how far one unit of insulin lowers glucose, in mg/dL.
Record carbs eaten without a bolus.
A change still collecting its 14 days of after data.
The middle value of the profile at that time of day.
A recurring glucose outcome the engine detected, such as highs after meals.
Start a Focus on a Pattern's habit.
A question about a low, asking whether carbs were eaten.
The active pump settings, read-only.
The ranked list of recommendations.
The engine's interval for the statistic it sits next to.
An answer or entry was saved.
Bring a snoozed item back.
A pump value: basal, correction factor or carb ratio.
A new infusion site and cartridge, as the pump logged it.
The pump's sleep schedule, when Control-IQ runs its tighter overnight target.
Remove from the Queue for 14 days. It returns early if the evidence changes.
The vendor account the data syncs from.
A pump setting change the app detected, watched against its before period.
Not yet clear enough to act on: the evidence behind it is thin.
Reverse the last snooze.
A Prompt's answers. False low marks the reading itself as invalid.
glossary.term: Yes / No / False low / Not sure
